firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: both round-3 mustFixes cleared. The fog is darkened behind the text column, the dial labels are paper serif (Winter / Spring / Fall / Summer) and read clearly, and the dial is now four segments with Fall filled and 'Now Fall' at its centre. The page reads as an almanac cover. 1024-first.jpg: the labels no longer collide. 390-first.jpg: h1 is 3 lines and both actions sit above the fold. Held at 9 because about 180px of empty dark fog sits under the buttons at 1440 and a stray ghost arc crosses the h1 at 390.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the dial carries the page (hero, almanac index, every dateline, the sticky dial reading SUMMER/WINTER in 1440-scroll-25.jpg and 1440-scroll-50.jpg, the countdown ring, the reviews mark, the footer). Still two template shapes: the 3x3 services grid and the 3x2 equal review-card grid (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Season tags on the cards help, but the layouts are the generic ones (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: a tight display serif with real scale contrast. The dial labels moved from mono caps to serif, so the hero now has only two mono strings. Curly quotes and en-dash ranges are correct (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg). Not higher because mono is still on every dateline, chip, review name and service tag (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: a real tonal rhythm (deep / brass / paper / slate / photo break / paper / deep / paper / white / deep / paper / deep). The pollen price chip now holds its text and the winter spread is re-cut with a full-width photo and a two-column foot (1440-full.jpg). Minor: a dead band of about 130px under the services grid (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: one warm sepia grade now runs across the set and the green cloth is gone. The shower frame is clean (1440-scroll-25.jpg). Still generic: the spring figure is a microfiber cloth, not pollen, a porch or a screen. The cabin bath is still a flat flash snapshot, even after grading (1440-scroll-50.jpg).

copy.notes: The primary action is now one name, 'Price my cleaning' (1440-first.jpg, 390-first.jpg, 1440-scroll-25.jpg). Reviews are concrete and local and everything carries a Sample label (1440-scroll-75.jpg). -0.5: Ruby H.'s mildew quote appears twice, word for word, in the summer spread (1440-scroll-25.jpg) and in the review grid (1440-scroll-75.jpg). The heading promises 'season by season', but the grid is not ordered or grouped by season.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 is 3 lines, both actions are above the fold and the sticky Call / Price bar is in place. render.json shows no overflow at 320 or 390. 390-full.jpg: spreads stack image-then-text and the countdown ring fits the thumb. Deductions: a faint brass dial arc runs behind 'Chattanooga,' in the h1 at 390-first.jpg and reads as a smudge, not the signature. The services become a long run of 9 stacked rows (390-full.jpg).

a11y.notes: 1440-first.jpg / 390-first.jpg: the hero labels and eyebrow now sit on a dark scrim in paper colour. 1440-rm-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg: every word is visible in reduced motion. render.json shows no errors. Every review, the rating and every price carries a Sample label (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg / 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the sticky dial turns and relabels SUMMER -> WINTER through the spreads. The hero dial now fills its quarter (1440-first.jpg) and the countdown ring draws its arc (390-full.jpg). Outside the dial, nothing visible has a choreographed moment: the spreads, the break band and the reviews enter with plain reveals.

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: the countdown tool answers in the dial's language (a 20 DAYS OUT ring with book-by / deep-clean / touch-up ticks and a dated list). It only covers the fall holidays, though. The whole-year planner the concept promises is still not on screen, and the tool's output can't be kept.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the label collision, chip overflow, shower sliver and every-link arrows are all gone. The footer is a designed close with the dial. Left: the duplicated Ruby H. quote (1440-scroll-25.jpg + 1440-scroll-75.jpg) and the ghost arc behind the h1 at 390-first.jpg.

elevate.move: Turn the two template grids into almanac pages. Set the services as a four-quarter ledger under a large dial: each quarter gets its own column with that season's jobs, and the all-year jobs go in the centre. Lay the reviews along the same ring, one quote per season with its month dateline, in place of the six equal cards.

Give the dial one scroll-driven hand-off. The hero dial shrinks into the sticky corner dial as the hero leaves, and each spread's dateline icon fills its quarter as the spread enters. The signature then moves in a single continuous line from the cover to the footer, instead of plain reveals between turns.
